citations.claim: at first violating step 1 controller applied 6.5N exceeding fmax 5; body accelerated to speed ~0.217

counterfactual.change: set controller noise 1 -> 0, keeping all else identical; commanded force then stays within fmax and no violation occurs

explanation: Seeded sensor noise is added to the velocity-error control force after (or without) the fmax clamp, so commanded force 6.5 exceeds limit 5. With noise=0 the same scenario commands ~within limit and passes, confirming noise bypasses the limiter.
vision_note: The red controller-driven circle sits on the left far from the green waypoint in the upper right, moving almost imperceptibly between step 0 and step 1. There is no visible collision, escape, or erratic motion, so nothing looks physically broken to the eye.
